name: Sid Viswanathan
current_role: Co-founder & Co-CEO, Alchemy (in-house pharmacies for 340B safety-net clinics)
profile: Co-founded digital pharmacy/health-infrastructure company Truepill in 2016 with pharmacist Umar Afridi; served as President, then CEO from 2022 (Series D valued it at $1.6B). Now co-CEO of Alchemy, which builds in-house pharmacies for safety-net clinics serving people with HIV and Hepatitis C; it raised a $31M a16z-led seed in Oct 2024.
interesting_fact: Alchemy's $31M seed round was led by a16z Bio + Health, with Magic Johnson among the investors.
deep_cut_fact: Started his career in Johnson & Johnson's Global Operations Leadership Development program, then founded CardMunch, a business-card scanning app acquired by LinkedIn, where he became a product manager.
notes: Left Truepill in 2023; best angle is Alchemy / 340B pharmacy. Co-CEO with Peter Park (ex-Truepill).
